User-stated requirement explicitly expects q=saudi → JED, RUH, etc. Fix: enrich each airport row with a country_name (from a name map or by reverse-lookup), or extend the search loop to also test the country full name from a code→name map.

rca_of_issue: Frontend SyntaxError RCA: when the StyleSheet.create block was edited, an old fragment of the previous styles (starting at `nItems: 'center'`) was left in place after the new closing `});`. JS parser sees `});` at line 760, then `nItems` on line 761 as a top-level statement → 'Missing semicolon'. Reproduce: open https://smart-travel-deals-4.preview.emergentagent.com on mobile viewport — Metro/Expo serves the red error overlay instead of the app. Mitigation: remove lines 761-774 entirely; the stylesheet that ends at line 760 is the correct/complete one. Backend 'saudi' search RCA: airport_data.py line 120 stores `country = iso_country.upper()` (ISO-2). server.py search_airports.py only checks `country.startswith(query)` / `query in country` against this 2-char code, so 'saudi' (5 chars) can never match. Mitigation: add a country_name field at enrich time using a complete ISO-2→name map (pycountry or hand-rolled) and include it in the score loop.
